- Multiple elongated septate conidiophores radiating outward
- Oval/elliptical multicellular conidia at tips with visible internal structure
- Credited to Bruce Watt (Bugwood 5505971)

These features are characteristic of **Alternaria** — muriform conidia, septate conidiophores, central stroma. Now I'll view one reference image to confirm.

The reference confirms: the Alternaria class shows muriform, septate conidia with a dark stromatic mass — matching the test image closely. The test image shows intact conidiophores still bearing conidia, while the reference shows freed conidia, but the morphology (oval/elliptical multicellular conidia, dark stroma, septate hyphae) is consistent.
